description: This file contains test cases for the 'inbound-context.js' module related to Discord inbound context helpers. It uses the 'vitest' testing framework to verify functions that build access contexts and check permissions based on user roles and message contexts.

methods.name: createDiscordSupplementalContextAccessChecker
methods.description: Creates a function to check if a user has access to a supplemental context based on channel configuration, roles, and user names.

methods.name: buildDiscordGroupSystemPrompt
methods.description: Generates a system prompt string for a Discord group, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: buildDiscordInboundAccessContext
methods.description: Constructs an access context object based on channel config, guild info, sender info, and message details.

methods.name: buildDiscordUntrustedContext
methods.description: Builds an array of untrusted context strings based on the message context and channel topic.
